title: Derivative within M along chart directions equals the derivative of a local extension
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ (ℝ^d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), M ⊆ ℝᴺ, V ⊆ ℝⁿ, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ, f, g : ℝᴺ → L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ) and x₀ ∈ ℝⁿ. Assume five things: V is a neighbourhood of x₀; ψ(V) ⊆ M; ψ is differentiable at x₀; g is differentiable at ψ(x₀); and f(z) = g(z) for every z ∈ M in some neighbourhood of ψ(x₀), i.e. f =ᶠ[𝓝[M] ψ x₀] g. Then for every a ∈ ℝⁿ, fderivWithin ℝ f M (ψ x₀) (Dψ(x₀)a) = Dg(ψ(x₀))(Dψ(x₀)a) in L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ). Here Dψ(x₀) = fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ and Dg(y) = fderiv ℝ g y.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (f g : Rn N → (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N)) (x₀ : Rn n), V ∈ 𝓝 x₀ → ψ '' V ⊆ M → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ g (ψ x₀) → f =ᶠ[𝓝[M] ψ x₀] g → ∀ a : Rn n, fderivWithin ℝ f M (ψ x₀) (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ a) = fderiv ℝ g (ψ x₀) (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ a)
